subject: Module certification + secret sweep for private deployments (IaC)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Module certification + secret sweep for private deployments (IaC)

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Following up from last week's audit kick-off: the security team finished a first-pass secret-scan across the private-deploy IaC repo (terraform/, helm/, ansible/). I attached the scanner output and an exported module inventory. High-level findings: 

- A handful of Terraform modules (modules/vpc-bridge, modules/bastion-proxy) include test credentials in examples/ that were accidentally left in history.
- Several Helm chart values.yml templates reference cloud-provider IDs that look like service-account emails (possible copy/paste).
- A small set of Ansible playbooks contain plaintext host credentials inside vars/ (ansible/roles/sftp/tasks/main.yml).

We need a short, auditable remediation plan for Acme's compliance team and SOC2 auditors. Proposed immediate actions:

1) "Secret sweep" branch that removes sensitive examples and rotates any real keys.
2) Add pre-commit secret scanning (gitlab CI job) and require pass-to-merge on all private deploy MRs.
3) Certification checklist for each module: owner, supported environments, approved KMS key id, and whether values are templated for Vault/KMS.
4) A minimal remediation MR template for infra stewards to use (link to MR -> template).

Can you two help own the certification artifacts? Target: initial remediation branch by EOD Thursday (2026-12-10) and a one-hour sync with Acme next Friday.

Attachments: module_inventory.csv, secret_scan_report.html

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Module certification + secret sweep for private deployments (IaC)

Naomi — thanks for the scan and clear summary. Agree with your remediation plan. Two quick asks: 

- Ensure the Terraform state references are NOT included in the scan export (we'll scrub anything that looks like live state).
- Prioritize modules that are in the Acme deploy path: modules/vpc-bridge, modules/enclave-proxy, modules/storage-gateway.

Marissa — can you own the module certification checklist and the MR template? I'll take point on coordinating the rotation with Acme's infra team (Victor).

If you want, we can use the private-iaC project in GitLab to stage the sweep branch and gate it behind a temporary protected pipeline.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Dedicated & Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Alice Torres <alice@secureaudit.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 11:20:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Module certification + secret sweep for private deployments (IaC)

Hi all — thanks for looping me in. A few quick notes from the external audit side: 

- We can accept a remediation MR plus a signed certification table for each module; the table needs: module name, owner, last-tested commit, KMS key ID used for secrets, evidence link (MR or runbook).
- For any rotated credentials, please provide a redaction log and rotation timestamps (this is a common SOC evidence request).
- We recommend Ansible vault for playbooks and interpolated Helm values from Vault for charts rather than hardcoded values.

I have availability next Friday at 09:00 PT for a 30–45 minute call to review the remediation artifacts. If you want us to run an independent quick scan after your sweep, we can schedule that as well (couple hours).

Best,
Alice Torres
Senior Auditor, SecureAudit LLC
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 13:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Module certification + secret sweep for private deployments (IaC)

Folks — I drafted a remediation plan and a compact certification checklist (attached). Implementation notes from my side: 

- Terraform: create a sweep branch that removes example credentials and moves any examples/ into examples-disabled/; add a new pre-merge job (ci/secret-scan) in .gitlab-ci.yml that fails on high-confidence matches. For state leaking in history, we'll run git-filter-repo and prepare a rewrite branch; we will not rewrite branches that are referenced by active prod tags without approval.
- Helm: update charts/*/values.schema.json and require values to use vault:// or k8s:secret references for sensitive fields. Add a Helm-lint stage to CI.
- Ansible: convert obvious plaintext vars to ansible-vault and add an ansible-lint rule; inventory files will be moved out of the repo and referenced from the deployment-only secrets bucket (accessed via KMS).
- CI/CD: add a temporary protected variable group for rotation tokens and require MR approvals from infra-stewards group.

I've enumerated owners in the checklist and created initial Jira tickets for the three prioritized modules: SEC-1298 (vpc-bridge), SEC-1299 (enclave-proxy), SEC-1300 (storage-gateway).

I'll push the remediation branch to private-iaC/sweep/module-sweep-20261209 by EOD Thursday and open MR templates per Rishi's ask.

Attachment: remediation_plan.md

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Staff Infrastructure Engineer (Private Deployments)
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Victor Huang <victor@acme-fin.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Module certification + secret sweep for private deployments (IaC)

Thanks Marissa — that plan looks good. Victor, looping you from Acme so we can coordinate the key rotations and timeline. Proposed flow: 

1) Marissa pushes sweep branch and opens MR (gitlab link) -> internal review + secret-scan must pass.
2) Acme rotates any customer-facing service account keys (Victor's team). Provide rotation timestamps and redaction log.
3) We merge and cut a matching release tag; run a post-merge audit job that calls SecureAudit for a second scan.

Links:
- MR: https://gitlab.redwood.ai/redwood/private-iaC/-/merge_requests/472
- Jira: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SEC-1298

I'll mark the MR as high priority. Please confirm Victor if the Friday 09:00 PT slot works for a sync.

—Rishi
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Torres <alice@secureaudit.com>, Victor Huang <victor@acme-fin.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Module certification + secret sweep for private deployments (IaC)

All — quick confirmation after the sync: Marissa's sweep branch is up and CI has the new secret-scan job enabled (see MR notes). SecureAudit will run their follow-up scan after merge.

Action items for audit evidence:
- Marissa: attach the certification tables to SEC-1298/1299/1300.
- Victor: provide rotation log and signed attestation by EOD Friday.
- Rishi: sign-off on the MR and tag release.

I attached a small approval stamp we can include with the artifact set (approval_stamp.pdf). Once the artifacts are complete I'll assemble a single evidence bundle for Alice and the Acme compliance team.

Thanks everyone — Naomi
